collection.title: Suzuki Vitara 1989 to 1998 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Suzuki Vitara 1989 to 1998 requires a 17" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Vitara which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
